message:
Command `cat > /workspace/candidate_trace.json << 'EOF'
[
  {"step": 1, "file": "fuzz/client.c", "function": "FuzzerTestOneInput", "line": 84, "var": "buf", "code": "if (SSL_do_handshake(client) == 1)", "note": "Fuzz target feeds raw TLS server response bytes into the client handshake.", "role": "source", "phase": "format"},
  {"step": 2, "file": "ssl/statem/statem_clnt.c", "function": "tls_process_ske_dhe", "line": 2288, "var": "pkt", "code": "if (!tls_process_ske_dhe(s, pkt, &pkey))", "note": "Client processes ServerKeyExchange with DHE parameters from the server response.", "role": "propagation"},
  {"step": 3, "file": "ssl/statem/statem_clnt.c", "function": "tls_process_ske_dhe", "line": 2150, "var": "dh", "code": "if (EVP_PKEY_assign_DH(peer_tmp, dh) == 0)", "note": "DH object is assigned to peer_tmp; ownership of dh transfers to peer_tmp.", "role": "propagation"},
  {"step": 4, "file": "ssl/statem/statem_clnt.c", "function": "tls_process_ske_dhe", "line": 2157, "var": "EVP_PKEY_security_bits(peer_tmp)", "code": "if (!ssl_security(s, SSL_SECOP_TMP_DH, EVP_PKEY_security_bits(peer_tmp), 0, dh))", "note": "Security check fails because the DH prime is too small (bits < 80), triggering the error path.", "role": "propagation"},
  {"step": 5, "file": "ssl/statem/statem_clnt.c", "function": "tls_process_ske_dhe", "line": 2179, "var": "dh", "code": "DH_free(dh);", "note": "DH_free called on dh which is already owned by peer_tmp; this is the first free of the double-free.", "role": "root", "invariant": "DH object must not be freed twice"},
  {"step": 6, "file": "ssl/statem/statem_clnt.c", "function": "tls_process_ske_dhe", "line": 2180, "var": "peer_tmp", "code": "EVP_PKEY_free(peer_tmp);", "note": "EVP_PKEY_free(peer_tmp) frees the DH object again via evp_pkey_free_legacy -> DH_free -> CRYPTO_DOWN_REF, writing to already-freed memory (heap-use-after-free WRITE 4).", "role": "sink"}
]
EOF
echo "trace written"; bash submit.sh /workspace/poc.bin /workspace/candidate_trace.json` executed with exit code 0.

message.content:
Now I have the exact line numbers:
- Line 2150: `EVP_PKEY_assign_DH(peer_tmp, dh)` — dh becomes owned by peer_tmp
- Line 2157: `ssl_security(...)` — fails with DH_KEY_TOO_SMALL
- Line 2179: `DH_free(dh)` — double free (root)
- Line 2180: `EVP_PKEY_free(peer_tmp)` — frees dh again → use-after-free in DH_free via evp_pkey_free_legacy (sink)

Let me write the updated trace and submit.
